title: Ten charts on global energy and emissions trends since Paris treaty
script_intro: Six years ago, the world committed to a new climate future in Paris. But for energy CXOs, the real question is: what has *actually* changed on the ground since then? Navigating the rapidly evolving energy landscape – from policy shifts to market dynamics – demands more than just headlines. Without clear, data-driven insights into global energy and emissions trends, strategic planning becomes a gamble, risking costly missteps and missed opportunities in this critical transition period. That's why we're cutting through the noise. In this video, we'll present ten compelling charts that reveal the undeniable shifts in global energy consumption, production, and emissions since the Paris Agreement. From the surprising surge in renewables to persistent challenges in decarbonization, these insights are crucial for making informed decisions. Stay tuned to discover the real story behind the numbers and what it means for your organization's future.
caption: For Energy CXOs navigating the complex landscape of global climate policy and market shifts, understanding the true impact of the Paris Agreement is paramount. This video delivers ten essential charts detailing global energy and emissions trends since 2015, offering the data-driven clarity needed to inform strategic decisions and identify key opportunities in the ongoing energy transition.
